{{Top|leg}}
'''Holocast''' was the term used to describe any [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] transmission distributing information to the galactic public. Usually, there were local holocasts to certain [[Star system|systems]] or [[List of planets/Legends|planets]]. But most of the time, the ruling faction had one that brought urgent news and propaganda which was sent throughout the galaxy by relay comm towers.
